-- Update rain_escape_options to populate new cost fields from existing price fields
UPDATE rain_escape_options SET
  systemMaterialCostPerSqft = ROUND(systemPricePerSqft * 0.55, 2),
  systemInstallCostPerSqft = ROUND(laborPricePerSqft * 0.55, 2),
  gutterMaterialCostPerLf = ROUND(gutterPricePerLinearFt * 0.55, 2),
  gutterInstallCostPerLf = ROUND(gutterPricePerLinearFt * 0.10, 2),
  marginPct = 35.00
WHERE systemPricePerSqft > 0 OR gutterPricePerLinearFt > 0;

-- Update railing_options installCostPerLf (default to 40% of costPerLf as labor estimate)
UPDATE railing_options SET
  installCostPerLf = ROUND(costPerLf * 0.40, 2)
WHERE costPerLf > 0;

-- Recalculate railing pricePerLf from (costPerLf + installCostPerLf) / (1 - marginPct/100)
UPDATE railing_options SET
  pricePerLf = ROUND((costPerLf + installCostPerLf) / (1 - marginPct / 100), 2)
WHERE marginPct > 0;

-- Update facade_options installCostPerSqft (default to 40% of costPerSqft as labor estimate)
UPDATE facade_options SET
  installCostPerSqft = ROUND(costPerSqft * 0.40, 2)
WHERE costPerSqft > 0 AND installCostPerSqft = 0;

-- Recalculate facade pricePerSqft from (costPerSqft + installCostPerSqft) / (1 - marginPct/100)
UPDATE facade_options SET
  pricePerSqft = ROUND((costPerSqft + installCostPerSqft) / (1 - marginPct / 100), 2)
WHERE marginPct > 0 AND (costPerSqft > 0 OR installCostPerSqft > 0);

SELECT 'railing' as tbl, name, costPerLf, installCostPerLf, marginPct, pricePerLf FROM railing_options
UNION ALL
SELECT 'facade' as tbl, name, costPerSqft, installCostPerSqft, marginPct, pricePerSqft FROM facade_options;
